description.value: Wayne & Freda is a specialty coffee shop in downtown Penticton named after the grandparents of the owners, who met later in life at a local care home. The café focuses on sustainably sourced, award-winning single-origin coffees and a seasonally inspired food menu of house-made breakfast sandwiches, toasts, bowls, and smoothies. It bills itself as 'an oasis in downtown Penticton' and a place built around community connection.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: wall_loops (5 spaces) at 40m. Total: 5 spaces.
